decision: Selected the centroid of ALKIS parcel Hamm Marsch 949 (Wendenstraße 285), the parcel the Bezirksamt Hamburg-Mitte preliminary decision M-BP-864-2024 names for the IPHH4 data centres, as the project locator for the IPHH4 plot; the two building footprints within it are not separately located. Verifier change: scope corrected from campus_locator to project_locator because the operator's Wendenstraße 408 address lies about 0.56 km away and the selected sources do not locate IPHH2 or IPHH3 on or beside this parcel.
identity_bridge: Bezirksamt Hamburg-Mitte preliminary decision (Vorbescheid) M-BP-864-2024 of 23 May 2025, published on the Transparenzportal on 27 March 2026: new build of two data centres with generator towers and offices on Flurstück 949, Gemarkung Hamm Marsch; its plan attachments are numbered DE-IPHH4-...; the neighbouring building at Wendenstraße 255 is cited for the permitted height.

Bezirksamt Hamburg-Mitte building permit M-BP-2262-2025 of 20 July 2026 (Transparenzportal, published 29 July 2026): new build of two data centres with generator platforms, Gemarkung Hamm Marsch (address and parcel redacted), granted on site plan no. DE-IPHH4-BA-E0-INV-LA-M-52000; it cites preliminary decision M-BP-864-2024 and permits felling of trees on the embankment to the Mittelkanal.

Portus Data Centers release of September 2024: IPHH4 is located on the IPHH Internet Port Hamburg Wendenstrasse campus, adjacent to the existing IPHH3 data centre; two buildings with 12.8 MW IT load in total.

consistency_checks.adjoining_parcels: ALKIS bbox query (hh-alkis-flst-bbox-wenden285.gml): parcel 949 shares about 38 m of boundary with Mittelkanal parcel 174 (consistent with the permit's trees on the Mittelkanal embankment), about 36 m with Wendenstraße street parcel 581, and about 62 m with parcel 948 (Wendenstraße 279).
consistency_checks.other_parcels_numbered_949: The same query returns 56 parcels numbered 949; the 55 in other Hamburg Gemarkungen are excluded because the Vorbescheid names Gemarkung Hamm Marsch.
consistency_checks.adjoining_parcel_445: Parcel 445 (Wendenstraße; östlich Wendenstraße 285, 1,462 m2) adjoins parcel 949 to the east; the permit's trees 445-01 to 445-06 may stand on it. The union 949+445 has its centroid about 16 m east of the selected point, which lies inside the union.
consistency_checks.operator_address_distance: ALKIS parcel Hamm Marsch 194 (Wendenstraße 408, the IPHH office address) has its centroid about 564 m from the selected point (verifier query, not a fragment source).

transform_check: Parcel polygon (EPSG:25832, LGV Hamburg ALKIS vereinfacht WFS) centroid computed with shapely 2.1.1 and transformed to WGS84 with pyproj 3.7.1 (PROJ 9.5.1), always_xy.

excluded_coordinates.reason: Operator head-office address (ALKIS parcel centroid about 0.56 km from parcel 949), not the IPHH4 plot named in the permit file.
Not located by the selected sources; the point marks only the IPHH4 parcel.
